changelog: Merged upstream 2.0.5-beta.7: background-thread chat list building, scroll/generation lag fixes, Agy profile account switcher, Claude subagent rename/share/delete, and long-chat RAM optimization.
Added Quote Selected Text from the Markdown/Raw Payload dialog into the chat input bar.
Added Type command input to the Agy Voice Call overlay (wired to live UserTranscript) and moved Open to the top-right.
Removed expensive per-frame 16dp shadow on the Floating Chat overlay root for smoother dragging and typing.
Includes F2.0.5-update3 performance improvements (bounded feed cache, search indexing optimization, AOT install compilation).
